description.zh:
检查项的ID。

> 您可调用[ListCheckItemWarningSummary](~~ListCheckItemWarningSummary~~)接口获取检查项ID。
description.en:
The ID of the check item.

> Call the [ListCheckItemWarningSummary](~~ListCheckItemWarningSummary~~) operation to obtain the check item ID.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.
The reason for adding the whitelist entry.
The ID of the whitelist record.

description.zh: 需要去除白名单中的容器名称的资产UUID列表。
description.en: The list of asset UUIDs for which container names are to be removed from the whitelist.

The data source. Valid values:
- **default**: host
- **agentless**: agentless.

description.zh:
生效目标类型：
- **all_instance**：全部主机
- **instance**：部分主机
description.en:
The type of the target on which the whitelist takes effect. Valid values:
- **all_instance**: all servers
- **instance**: specific servers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas update-baseline-check-white-record --lang zh --check-id 16 --record-id 14 --source agentless --target-type all_instance --reason Manually_processed. --remove-container-uuids 0e7aac1c-6536-43d1-9df8-73e2a6500000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas UpdateBaselineCheckWhiteRecord --region cn-hangzhou --CheckId 16 --RemoveContainerUuids.1 '0e7aac1c-6536-43d1-9df8-73e2a6500000' --TargetType all_instance --Lang zh --RecordId 14 --Source agentless --Reason 'Manually_processed.'
